hero.headline: CELL TOWER LEASE
hero.body: Fair market value starts with knowing what your site delivers. We negotiate renewals, extensions, and buyouts for Canadian property owners.

about.imageAlt: Two professionals shaking hands over a lease agreement
about.heading: Unlock the full potential of your telecom lease renewal
about.body1: At CellWaves, we specialize in helping property owners maximize the value of their telecom lease agreements. We negotiate better lease renewal deals for owners leasing their land to telecom companies, the antennas typically 15-24 feet tall.
about.body2: Unlike other brokers, we don't secure new deals for property owners. We focus on those approached for lease renewals, turning an offer of a few hundred dollars into a deal worth thousands.

contact.title: Talk to a landlord side specialist
contact.intro: Free review. No obligation. Tell us about your lease and we respond within one business day.
contact.privacy: Your details stay private. We never share with carriers. No carrier affiliation.

insights.heading: Our latest blog and article
insights.sub: Practical reading on lease rates, negotiation, and what your site is really worth.

process.heading: How it works
process.sub: Three steps, no upfront fees, and you keep control of every decision.

sections.heading: Our expertise covers the full life of your lease
sections.sub: From the first proposal letter to the final buyout signature, we focus on one outcome: a stronger agreement for the property owner.

testimonials.title: What landlords say after the lease is signed
testimonials.sub: Seven reports from Quebec to British Columbia. Huge names, cities, and sites you can verify. Feedback first, identity below. No stock quotes.

whyChoose.heading: Why landlords choose CellWaves
whyChoose.sub: Carriers negotiate hundreds of leases a year. Most landlords sign one in a lifetime. We close that experience gap.
